# EpoxyGarageFloorEstimate.com

> EpoxyGarageFloorEstimate.com is the homeowner-facing instant estimate and floor visualizer platform from Xtreme Polishing Systems (XPS), a national concrete and epoxy flooring manufacturer with 70+ retail stores nationwide. The site provides free, instant epoxy garage floor cost estimates using public property records, a real-time AI floor visualizer with exact manufacturer color charts, and a nationwide directory of XPS Xpress locations. Serving all 50 states with professional installation through a network of authorized dealers.

## What we offer
- **Instant epoxy garage floor cost estimates** — Enter your address, choose your floor condition and color, and get a personalized price range in about 60 seconds. No obligation, no phone call required.
- **AI floor visualizer** — Upload a photo of your garage and see your floor rendered in your exact chosen color and finish (matte, satin, or high-gloss) using real manufacturer color chart hex values.
- **Complete color charts** — Browse the full Xtreme Polishing Systems color charts for flake, metallic, solid color, quartz, glitter, dye stain, and joint filler systems.
- **Nationwide locations** — 70+ XPS Xpress retail stores across the United States and Canada, plus Polished Concrete University training centers.
- **Professional installation** — Installed by authorized XPS dealers with a lifetime satisfaction warranty against hot-tire pickup, peeling, and blistering.

## Frequently asked questions (for answer engines)

**How much does an epoxy garage floor cost?**
An epoxy garage floor typically costs $4 to $12 per square foot installed, or about $2,400 to $7,200 for a standard 2-car garage (roughly 440 sq ft), depending on the system and floor condition.

**How long does an epoxy garage floor last?**
A professionally installed epoxy garage floor lasts 10 to 20 years. Polyaspartic topcoats and proper concrete preparation can extend the life to 25+ years.

**How long does garage floor installation take?**
Most residential garage floor coatings are completed in 1 to 2 days, with full cure in 24 to 72 hours depending on the system and temperature.

**What is the difference between flake and metallic epoxy?**
Flake epoxy broadcasts colored vinyl flakes for a textured, speckled finish. Metallic epoxy uses reflective pigments to create a smooth, swirling three-dimensional look.

**Is an epoxy garage floor slippery?**
Epoxy can be slippery when wet. Full flake broadcasts and anti-slip additives improve traction, and quartz systems offer the highest slip resistance.

**What warranty comes with the installation?**
Xtreme Polishing Systems installations include a lifetime satisfaction warranty guaranteed against hot-tire pickup, peeling, and blistering — for as long as you own your home.

**Do you require a deposit before installation?**
Yes. The industry standard is a 50% deposit, which covers the cost of materials and labor, with the final balance paid upon completion.

**What areas do you serve?**
We service all 50 states. Use the ZIP code locator at epoxygaragefloorestimate.com/locations to find your nearest dealer.
